proposal.model_rationale: I looked at the native 1750x1750 image, the page context and the region crop, and at enlarged crops of bands 1 (date and reference), 5 (table title), 14 and 16 (notes 1 and 3). The image is an Arabic letter from the Northern Region Investment Services Office (ref ٢٢٨/٢٠٢٦, dated ١٦ نوفمبر ٢٠٢٦م) to the Authority. It contains Table 8-1: a 4x4 ruled grid made of a header row and 3 member-category rows, giving issue periods of ٣, ٥ and ٨ working days. Below the table are three notes: the count starts on the working day after a complete application is received; the certificate is valid ninety (٩٠) days; applications are made through the portal only and are complete only with all listed documents. Under the notes are the Director's signature block, an empty stamp oval, a signature stroke and the fictional-document footer. The order of the title numeral was checked against the crop: it shows ١-٨ left to right, which is logical ٨-١ (Table 8-1, matching the page text). The grid bands (7–12) are covered by the table cells. Because the checker only reads the table's notes when a table is present, all bands outside the grid are recorded in table.notes with their own roles; this is stated in uncertainties. The two open tashkeel points are recorded in uncertain. validate_reading passes every check (RD1–RD8). prepared_by is left for the controller. Nothing is approved.
